CORRUPTED_BLADE_RELIC.title: Corrupted Blade
CORRUPTED_BLADE_RELIC.description: At the start of each combat, shuffle 1 [jitter][purple]Corruption[/purple][/jitter] into your draw pile.
CORRUPTED_BLADE_RELIC.flavor: A blade corrupted by something evil.
DU_VU_DOLL.title: Du-Vu Doll
DU_VU_DOLL.description: For each [jitter][purple]Curse[/purple][/jitter] in your [gold]Deck[/gold], start each combat with 1 additional [red]Strength[/red].
DU_VU_DOLL.flavor: A doll devised to gain strength from malicious energy.
ARMYNOMICON.title: Armynomicon
ARMYNOMICON.description: At the start of each combat, [gold]Summon Army 5[/gold].
ARMYNOMICON.flavor: A book devised to summon an army at the start of combat.
CURSED_KEY.title: Cursed Key
CURSED_KEY.description: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of each turn. Whenever you kill an [gold]Elite[/gold], obtain a [jitter][purple]Corruption[/purple][/jitter].
CURSED_KEY.flavor: You can feel the malicious energy emanating from the key. Power comes at a price.
NECRONOMICON.title: Necronomicon
NECRONOMICON.description: The first [gold]Attack[/gold] played each turn that costs 2 or more is played twice. When you take this relic, become [jitter][purple]Cursed[/purple][/jitter].
NECRONOMICON.flavor: Only a fool would try and harness this evil power. At night your dreams are haunted by images of the book devouring your mind.
BLUE_CANDLE.title: Blue Candle
BLUE_CANDLE.description:
[gold]Unplayable[/gold] [jitter][purple]Curse[/purple][/jitter] cards can now be played with different effects.
Whenever you play a [jitter][purple]Curse[/purple][/jitter], lose 1 HP and [gold]Exhaust[/gold] it.
BLUE_CANDLE.flavor: The flame ignites when shrouded in darkness.
DOOM_STONE.title: Doom Stone
DOOM_STONE.description: Whenever you apply [jitter][pink]Doom[/pink][/jitter] to yourself, gain 1 [red]Strength[/red].
DOOM_STONE.flavor: A stone that brings doom upon those who wield it.
DOOMED_BLADE.title: Doomed Blade
DOOMED_BLADE.description: At the start of each combat, shuffle 2 [jitter][purple]Corruption[/purple][/jitter] into your draw pile and apply {DoomPower} [jitter][pink]Doom[/pink][/jitter] to yourself.
DOOMED_BLADE.flavor: A blade doomed by something evil.
